# Draft:Tamanna Murdeshwar

Early Life and Training  Guru Smt. Tamanna Nair began her journey in Bharatnatyam at the age of four, under the esteemed guidance of her mother, Guru Mrs. Poonamtai Murdeshwar. She is one of the most distinguished disciples of the renowned Bharatnatyam Gurus Mrs. Poonam Murdeshwar (a disciple of Guru T. K. Mahalingam Pillai) and Guru Vasant Kumar Pillai of the Raja Rajeshwari Bharatnatyam Kalamandir, Matunga, Mumbai.
In addition to Bharatnatyam, she has also trained in Kathak under the guidance of renowned Gurus Asha Joglekar (Tai) and Dr. Rajkumar Ketkar.
Career  Guru Smt. Tamanna Nair holds a Master of Fine Arts (Alankar) from the Akhil Bhartiya Gandharva Mahavidyalay, and a Bachelor's degree in Home Science with Arts from SNDT University, Matunga.
She began teaching Bharatnatyam at the age of 14 and demonstrated her talent in Nattuvangam at a young age. Her performances are characterized by subtle Abhinaya and precise Nritta, along with a firm command of Talam. Besides her expertise in dance, she is also an accomplished Carnatic vocalist.
Guru Smt. Tamanna Nair has conducted workshops and lectures on folk dances, Bharatanatyam, and other cultural activities at various institutions including SNDT Women’s College, Pune Fine Arts, Ahmedabad Cultural Centre, Baroda Centre, and Akhil Bhartiya Gandharva Mahavidyalay Vashi. She has also choreographed numerous cultural programs.
Other Artistic Pursuits  Apart from her prowess in dance, Guru Smt. Tamanna Nair is a skilled dubbing artist. She has lent her voice to movies in regional languages such as Bengali, Kannada, and Tamil. Notably, she dubbed the famous cartoon character 'Tweety' in Hindi for Cartoon Network and has provided voices for other cartoons on Hungama TV and Pogo Channel.
Her passion for Abhinaya (expressions) led her to explore acting. She started her acting career in children’s plays and continued to act in Marathi plays written, directed, and produced by her mother, Mrs. Poonam Murdeshwar. She has also acted in commercial plays in Hindi and Marathi, including "Jau Bai Jorat," "Gangubai Matric," "Nari Jhalya Bhari," "Buddha Hoga Tera Baap," and "Jaanch Padtaal."
In the film industry, she has acted in movies like "Char Deewane Aur Ek Deewani Bhi," the Marathi film "Dhava Dhav" with actors Bharat Jadhav and Arun Kadam, and the recently released movie "Navra Majha Bhavara," where she played the lead role alongside actor Dr. Nilesh Sabale.
Current Role and Legacy  Guru Smt. Tamanna Nair currently teaches Bharatnatyam at Payal Nritya-Natya Niketan in Thane, an institution established by her mother, Guru Mrs. Poonamtai Murdeshwar, 45 years ago. She also teaches at Akhil Bharatiya Gandharva Mahavidyalaya Vashi and has 18 years of teaching experience.
Her dream is to expand the reach of Bharatnatyam to a wider audience while preserving its aesthetic value and cultural integrity. She is dedicated to passing on this divine art form to the next generation, training students who are passionate and committed to the discipline.
